races.name: Clonmel Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
This is wide open and it could pay to side with NELSON MUNTZ who returns from a break off a handy-looking mark and is taken to gain an overdue success at the chief expense of Downpatrick runner-up Dairy Force. Vaureal can also play a prominent role back in this sphere after a chasing victory at Punchestown. Max Meridius completes the shortlist back over a shorter trip.

  1. NELSON MUNTZ (IRE)
  2. DAIRY FORCE (IRE)
  3. VAUREAL (FR)

races.name: Slievenamon Claiming Hurdle
races.verdict:
BLACK HEATHER hasn't been seen over hurdles for nearly 15 months but has been in solid form on the Flat this summer and is greatly favoured on these terms so gets the nod. C&D winner Rocky's Howya rates a major threat as he bids to extend his unbeaten sequence in claimers to 5, while Rich Belief and Allo Al Khawaneej also enter the reckoning.

  1. BLACK HEATHER (IRE)
  2. ROCKY'S HOWYA (IRE)
  3. RICH BELIEF

races.name: Kilmore Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
HOWYASOX has been given plenty of time to recover from her fall at Cork in July and, back down in trip, should take plenty of beating in a winnable maiden if reproducing the form she looked set to show before departing. Vargas hasn’t shown much so far but represents a top yard and the booking of Jack Kennedy suggests better is expected, while Kalico Leader would ideally want further but is respected in a race lacking depth.

  1. HOWYASOX (IRE)
  2. VARGAS (IRE)
  3. KALICO LEADER (IRE)

races.name: Derrinlaur Mares Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
MISTY COVE has yet to match her Flat form in this sphere but shaped with more encouragement last time and, with the conditions of the race suiting and improvement likely, looks worth chancing in an open contest. Sallap boasts a good record here and rates the main danger after a career-best effort last time, while Demanding Gerry and Eaglewood are also respected.

  1. MISTY COVE (IRE)
  2. SALLAP (IRE)
  3. DEMANDING GERRY (IRE)

races.name: Ravens Rock Novice Handicap Hurdle (0-100)
races.verdict:
If IL SILENZIO can translate anything like his chase form this summer back to the smaller obstacles he should take a bit of stopping from his lower mark in this sphere. Shark Hanlon's Pure Logic rates an obvious danger after a string of good efforts in recent months. Boomerang Breeze is a potential improver in handicaps and is also shortlisted along with Bobby Kirova.

  1. IL SILENZIO
  2. PURE LOGIC
  3. BOOMERANG BREEZE (IRE)

races.name: Clonmel Novice Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
LOUIESCALL has run a couple of crackers on the Flat since his Tramore maiden success in July and might prove the answer back hurdling. Kashchei has a progressive profile over hurdles since the spring and can fill the forecast spot ahead of Hopeful Hero.

  1. LOUIESCALL (IRE)
  2. KASHCHEI
  3. HOPEFUL HERO (IRE)

races.name: Glenary Handicap Hurdle (0-100)
races.verdict:
TECHNOLOGY's latest Down Royal second received a boost when the third scored at Listowel last week and John McConnell's charge is taken to finally get off the mark. Poetic Focus had an excuse at Galway last time and may give the selection most to think about if back to the form she showed when second at Ballinrobe in August. Finnicky Filly is next on the list ahead of Private Policy.

  1. TECHNOLOGY (IRE)
  2. POETIC FOCUS (IRE)
  3. FINNICKY FILLY (IRE)

races.name: Racing TV Nursery Handicap
races.verdict:
CROMANE was much improved upped to this trip when off the mark on her nursery debut at Naas a fortnight ago and looks capable of defying a 7 lb higher mark, perhaps at the expense of Scarlet Dream, who promises to be much better suited by this longer distance having been taken off her feet on her first foray into nursery company at Fairyhouse (6f) recently.

  1. CROMANE
  2. SCARLET DREAM (IRE)
  3. IPPY (IRE)

races.name: Bellewstown Inn Fillies Maiden
races.verdict:
WHITE SAND BEACH needs to bounce back but sets the standard on her spring form and, freshened up by a short break, is worth one final chance to gain the win her pedigree demands. Tax Me Later improved from her course debut when a close second in a Gowran Park claimer and rates the main danger if progressing again for new connections, while Xirivella should be better suited by this shorter trip and looks best of the rest.

  1. WHITE SAND BEACH (USA)
  2. TAX ME LATER (IRE)
  3. XIRIVELLA (IRE)

races.name: Bluegrass Horse Feed Handicap (0-60)
races.verdict:
GLASARMI looks potentially interesting down in grade. She's narrowly preferred to in-form Nephin Mountain and Glen Breeze, who makes only his second start over this trip.

  1. GLASARMI (IRE)
  2. NEPHIN MOUNTAIN (IRE)
  3. GLEN BREEZE (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Handicap
races.verdict:
LADY IN GOLD left her debut form well behind to score at Dundalk in February despite still looking a bit rough around the edges, so it's reasonable to assume she can progress further now entering handicap company. Tachos could well bounce back on her return to calmer waters, while Save The Sixes is another unexposed, well-bred filly who warrants respect.

  1. LADY IN GOLD (IRE)
  2. TACHOS (IRE)
  3. SAVE THE SIXES (IRE)

races.name: Johnny Kierans Memorial Handicap (0-60)
races.verdict:
STEEL MAGNOLIA ticks plenty of boxes and gets the nod ahead of El Fontenaro and Ballysax Lil' Mick.

  1. STEEL MAGNOLIA (IRE)
  2. EL FONTENARO (IRE)
  3. BALLYSAX LIL' MICK (IRE)

races.name: Kilsaran Race
races.verdict:
COUNT BEZUKHOV continued a theme of gradual progression when making a winning handicap debut at Listowel last week and with better still to come, Joseph O'Brien's colt can record his third career success. Stablemate Magnum Cor heads up the dangers having scored in the manner of one who will go on improving for a while at Roscommon in August, while Abbotsford looks the only other conceivable threat.

  1. COUNT BEZUKHOV (IRE)
  2. MAGNUM COR (IRE)
  3. ABBOTSFORD

races.name: BOYLE Sports Handicap (0-60) (Div 1)
races.verdict:
LILY PARR is yet to get her head in front but with this return to 1½m promising to suit, Sheila Lavery's filly gets the tentative vote to cash in on a reduced mark at the expense of Searcog, who scored at Punchestown around this time last year and arrives fit from a spell over timber. Maxwell Smart and Sneddy Eddie can do battle for minor honours.

  1. LILY PARR
  2. SEARCOG (IRE)
  3. MAXWELL SMART (IRE)

races.name: BOYLE Sports Handicap (0-60) (Div 2)
races.verdict:
GREY FABLE arrives in good form, beaten only by a 3-y-o improver at Beverley last time, and is fancied to resume winning ways as he drops back in grade. Acanto took a step forward on her handicap debut and the lightly-raced 4-y-o could be the main danger, ahead of Autocrat from his much-reduced mark on turf.

  1. GREY FABLE (IRE)
  2. ACANTO (IRE)
  3. AUTOCRAT (IRE)

races.name: Weatherbys Racing Bank Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
GONE IN SIXTY isn't an obvious follow-up candidate given his record but with Sean Bowen retaining the ride, he's worth chancing to defy a 5 lb higher mark for his Stratford success. Soldier In Mayo shaped well on last month's return/chasing debut behind a well-handicapped rival at Bangor and rates next best with improvement likely. Sedgefield scorer Socks Off rounds off the shortlist.

  1. GONE IN SIXTY
  2. SOLDIER IN MAYO (IRE)
  3. SOCKS OFF (IRE)

races.name: Paul Ferguson's Jumpers To Follow Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
The return to a slightly longer trip should suit PAPER MILL, who is taken to inflict a first Southwell defeat on No More No.

  1. PAPER MILL
  2. NO MORE NO (IRE)
  3. ALRIGHT DAI (IRE)

races.name: Jodie Standing's Point-To-Point Recruits Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
MOMENTS AWAY displayed race-by-race progress in 4 bumper starts, posting a solid fifth in an Aintree Grade 2 when last seen in the spring. His pedigree/physique point to him making a splash over hurdles and he's fancied to make a bold bid partnered by Sean Bowen. Iamyouare is put forward to lay down the sternest challenge over recent chase winner Gaelic Rambler.

  1. MOMENTS AWAY (IRE)
  2. IAMYOUARE (IRE)
  3. GAELIC RAMBLER (IRE)

races.name: 'Smooth Radio - Always The Best Music' Novices' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
CRAFTY GAEL relished the step up to 3m last time and can make it back-to-back wins for the Olly Murphy team. Captain Connor has each-way claims, while Could Be You is worth noting for support from his lowly mark, in what hardly looks a strong contest for the grade.

  1. CRAFTY GAEL (IRE)
  2. CAPTAIN CONNOR (FR)
  3. COULD BE YOU (IRE)

races.name: Old Stag 70th Birthday Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
In a wide-open handicap, KING OF THE ROAD appeals most off his much-reduced mark. Granny Hawkins is going the right way, and she's feared most in a race that should be run to suit.

  1. KING OF THE ROAD (IRE)
  2. GRANNY HAWKINS
  3. MAX OF STARS (FR)

races.name: Weatherbys nhstallions.co.uk Conditional Jockeys' Training Series Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
Bangor specialist Rock Hurley will likely get the run of the race, but improving 4-y-o CRACK OPS may progress again to make a winning return.

  1. CRACK OPS
  2. ROCK HURLEY (FR)
  3. SPOT ON SOPH (IRE)

races.name: Follow AtTheRaces On Instagram Handicap
races.verdict:
L'EAGLE AID did well under the circumstances having been kept much handier than the first 2 in a well-run race at Pontefract last week and looks ready to strike. Jujubella goes well at this track and ought to give another good account, while Junkyard Dog also merits consideration with the step back up in trip in his favour.

  1. L'EAGLE AID (IRE)
  2. JUJUBELLA (IRE)
  3. JUNKYARD DOG (IRE)

races.name: Free Tips Daily On attheraces.com EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
SAINT OF SEVILLE showed promise when strong in the betting first time up for top connections and has the pedigree to improve markedly, so he's taken to get the better of a similarly well-bred sort in Night of Gold, while Ring of Music needs a look in the betting given his profile.

  1. SAINT OF SEVILLE
  2. NIGHT OF GOLD
  3. RING OF MUSIC (IRE)

races.name: Free Race Replays On attheraces.com Nursery
races.verdict:
HAVANA LIGHTNING wasn't discredited sporting a first-time tongue tie when sixth in listed company at Newbury last time and now dropping into much calmer waters, George Boughey's filly earns the vote to double her tally. Not My Type fared a lot better making her nursery debut back over 5f at Newmarket last week, so she may emerge as the main threat, with Blake's Monarch rounding off the shortlist.

  1. HAVANA LIGHTNING
  2. NOT MY TYPE
  3. BLAKE'S MONARCH (IRE)

races.name: Download The Racecourse App Raceday Ready Handicap
races.verdict:
SAILOR’S RETURN won at Southwell in August and shaped better than the result from 3 lb higher there a fortnight ago. With Newcastle expected to suit, she looks the one to side with. Alkumatic Jo Jo remains competitively treated and can be involved if reproducing her recent Kempton effort, while Dalamara ran well under a penalty over this C&D last time and should be suited by the return to 1m.

  1. SAILOR'S RETURN
  2. ALKUMATIC JO JO (IRE)
  3. DALAMARA

races.name: Download The Raceday Ready App Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict:
LADY KODIAC found further improvement when recording a third career success over C&D last month and with a 3 lb nudge seeming far from insurmountable, James Tate's filly gets the verdict to follow up. Vanilla Skies ran well in a change of equipment when third on her recent handicap debut and she could provide most resistance, with stable-switcher D Flawless taken to fill out third.

  1. LADY KODIAC (IRE)
  2. VANILLA SKIES
  3. D FLAWLESS (IRE)

races.name: Get Raceday Ready Handicap
races.verdict:
ESPANITA arrives in top form, conceding first run when second at Wolverhampton 10 days ago, and she is taken to land her fourth all-weather success. The main danger could be Egotistical as she goes up in trip, with Record Day completing the shortlist.

  1. ESPANITA (IRE)
  2. EGOTISTICAL
  3. RECORD DAY

races.name: Free Digital Racecard At raceday-ready.com Handicap
races.verdict:
SERGEANT MAYER is thriving at present, completing the hat-trick with a bit to spare at Redcar last week, so a penalty might not prevent him from scoring again. Dc Cogent is also in good heart having dropped in the weights and is the pick for second, ahead of Cotai Starlight.

  1. SERGEANT MAYER (IRE)
  2. DC COGENT
  3. COTAI STARLIGHT (IRE)

races.name: Follow AtTheRaces On X Handicap
races.verdict:
LITTLE TED got back to winning ways in decisive fashion at Hamilton 10 days ago and, without a penalty for that victory, he is fancied to follow up in his current form. 3-time C&D winner Just Typical isn't taken lightly, though, while Falcon Nine arrives in good heart and is also considered.

  1. LITTLE TED
  2. JUST TYPICAL
  3. FALCON NINE

races.name: Salisbury Annual Badgeholders 'Bluestocking' British EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
Ralph Beckett has a fine record in this so his Frankel newcomer YAMANA, who fetched 1,500,000 guineas as a yearling, is taken to make a winning start at the chief expense of Somerton, who rates the clear pick of those with experience. A few other debutants also catch the eye though, including Gran Dia and the selection's stablemate Star Rose, in this fascinating novice.

  1. YAMANA
  2. SOMERTON (IRE)
  3. GRAN DIA (IRE)

races.name: 'Pyledriver' British EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div 1)
races.verdict:
The betting should prove highly informative here but Ed Walker's METICULOUSLY shaped with promise when a debut fourth at Leicester and this well-related son of Sioux Nation can build on it to thwart Ralph Beckett's New Bay newcomer Forest Bay, who appeals on pedigree. Gold Army has the form to play a prominent role, while Does Mary Know is not out of things if shrugging off a lesser effort at Ascot.

  1. METICULOUSLY
  2. FOREST BAY
  3. GOLD ARMY

races.name: 'Pyledriver' British EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div 2)
races.verdict:
MOON ROCK was in need of the initial experience when a promising sixth in a valuable Ascot maiden and Ed Walker's Sea The Moon colt looks the way to go with improvement very much on the cards. Newcomers Showmaster and Vulcanist are in excellent hands and appeal on pedigree too so rate threats, especially if the market vibes are positive. Kamaal is another who can play a prominent role if rediscovering his best form.

  1. MOON ROCK (FR)
  2. SHOWMASTER
  3. VULCANIST

races.name: British EBF Joan Snow Memorial Conditions Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
None of these can be ruled out but the vote goes to DANCE A JIG who holds the edge on form and can double his tally on the back of a good Ayr listed third when perked up by a first-time visor (also worn here). A Bear Affair also brings some very solid form to the table and seems sure to go well, while the consistent Social Symbol is another to factor into this conditions event.

  1. DANCE A JIG
  2. A BEAR AFFAIR (IRE)
  3. SOCIAL SYMBOL (USA)

races.name: Sandown Kia Salisbury Handicap
races.verdict:
BROSAY looks on a handy mark following back-to-back seconds, and he may go one better here. Unexposed handicap debutant Jellystone Park is feared, along with fellow 3-y-o Regional Rock, while Mythical Composer is one to consider at bigger prices.

  1. BROSAY
  2. JELLYSTONE PARK
  3. REGIONAL ROCK

races.name: Barbara Snow 60th Birthday Celebration Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
BNAIDER is taken to overcome an absence and make it 2 wins from 3 in handicaps. Mr Seagull is feared off a much-reduced mark, with Morcar likely to give another good account.

  1. BNAIDER
  2. MR SEAGULL (IRE)
  3. MORCAR

races.name: Barbara Snow 60th Birthday Celebration Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
A case can be made for a few of these but BLUE WONDER still looks ahead of her mark despite being raised 5 lb for a stylish Goodwood success so looks the way to go. Wuood should find this step up in trip to his benefit and heads the list of dangers, while Sintra and Sergei Breeze also need factoring into an intriguing handicap.

  1. BLUE WONDER (IRE)
  2. WUOOD
  3. SINTRA

races.name: Madar Corporation 'Season Finale' Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
Ralph Beckett's DIALSTONE gets the nod in a race where several look potentially well treated. Fellow handicap debutant Treble Bass heads the dangers, along with Roc De Fer, while support for either Harry Derham runner is likely to be telling.

  1. DIALSTONE
  2. TREBLE BASS
  3. ROC DE FER (IRE)

races.name: EBF Slip Anchor Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
CAELUM shaped quite well on his Newcastle debut and might be able to improve past Lady Branksome, who sets the standard on her Ripon second but has been off since a disappointing effort at Chester in mid-June.

  1. CAELUM (IRE)
  2. LADY BRANKSOME (IRE)
  3. VIKING BARBIE (IRE)

races.name: Racedays For 9 Pound At Nottingham Racecourse Nursery
races.verdict:
PRIDE OF TOLEDO is given a second chance to show that his mark is workable. Pure Mint had a possible excuse when turned over at short odds at Ascot last time and his debut success prior to that was highly promising so he's a potential big threat. Horndean and Washington Royale also make the shortlist.

  1. PRIDE OF TOLEDO (IRE)
  2. PURE MINT (IRE)
  3. HORNDEAN (FR)

races.name: Watch Racing TV Handicap
races.verdict:
PACIFIC STORM has yet to show much but hails from a stable that has found form recently and can improve them markedly in handicaps so he's worth a chance to live up to the stamina in his pedigree in a race lacking depth. Corsican Caper and Noble Grace may be ones to pick up any pieces.

  1. PACIFIC STORM (FR)
  2. CORSICAN CAPER (IRE)
  3. NOBLE GRACE (IRE)

races.name: EBF Oh So Sharp Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
THI QAR has looked a useful prospect on both starts and should make it third time lucky. Princess Lottie's latest near miss in a nursery at Haydock was boosted when the winner followed up with something to spare back there last week and she can give the Gosden filly most to think about

  1. THI QAR (IRE)
  2. PRINCESS LOTTIE
  3. EMPRESS JINGU

races.name: 9 Pound Racedays At Nottingham Racecourse Handicap
races.verdict:
This is a pretty useful handicap but KAINDY still rather stands out as a progressive sort from a leading yard. Fellow 3-y-o Phantom Watch goes off the same mark as when runner-up at Windsor last month and is second choice ahead of Rogue Defence and Empire of Light.

  1. KAINDY (IRE)
  2. PHANTOM WATCH (IRE)
  3. ROGUE DEFENCE

races.name: Hospitality At Nottingham Racecourse Handicap
races.verdict:
CELESTIAS COMET was a comfortable winner over C&D in July and, though she flopped at Sandown next time, she could bounce back returned to this venue with the likely solid pace in her favour. Didaar is another to note returned to this C&D and could take a hand if his wide draw doesn't prove prohibitive, while veteran front-runner Garden Oasis is lurking on an attractive mark and could well make a bold bid from stall 2.

  1. CELESTIAS COMET (IRE)
  2. DIDAAR (IRE)
  3. GARDEN OASIS

races.name: Construction Day 14th Oct Handicap
races.verdict:
ACT OF VIOLENCE has held his form well since winning at Ripon in July and, with pace down the centre of the track, he could get a good tow into this race and come out on top again. Trafalger is well treated if confirming his recent return to form and looks a danger, while Spirit of Applause makes obvious appeal down in 0-70 company if stall 1 doesn't prove a hindrance.

  1. ACT OF VIOLENCE
  2. TRAFALGER
  3. SPIRIT OF APPLAUSE

races.name: Prix Philippe De Bourgoing Maiden Stakes
Race 7 - Greg Veit Scarlet And Gray Stakes
Race 5 - Belmont Turf Sprint Stakes - Grade 3
Race 7 - Joe Hirsch Turf Classic Stakes - Grade 1
